findings.evidence: record row s006 (Outputs, units para:052b1969, para:b5f9ab9c, para:13995122, para:da9fe7d4) is fate removed-to-fit, value real, decision restore-main, but Done and output still omits caller-visible delegation rationale: the row itself says Result, Changes, Validation and Remaining blockers never report who did each subtask and why
findings.fix: Restore the caller-visible line into Done and output, as the restore-main row requires: in Result, name who did each subtask directly or via which specialist and why. Do not drop the row.

findings.evidence: Process step 2 says "first find the gates (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, Makefile; else the toolchain's test runner), then run them": which restates harness and toolchain behavior the model already performs
findings.fix: Keep the non-obvious parts (list pre-existing failures, reproduce before fixing, stop only the unreproducible requirement) and move the gate-discovery sentence into a bundled skill the plugin preloads via skills:, recording the move; do not delete it outright

findings.evidence: House rules "Write code, comments, docs and commit messages in English" is a generic preference with no environment-specific failure mode, unlike the checkout, context and index gotchas
findings.fix: Replace it with the failure it prevents (for example a mixed-language commit message that breaks the project's changelog parser) or move the language rule into the plugin's shared conventions skill and record the move

findings.evidence: "do each bounded subtask directly when your tools and scope allow, even if a specialist matches; delegate only when its domain rules or tools add something you lack" leaves the implement-versus-delegate choice as a judgment with no default example
findings.fix: Add one default: implement a local edit yourself; delegate only when the specialist's tool list or domain rule is required, naming that missing capability in the reason

findings.evidence: Step 5 "try one documented setup fix, else mark unverified" never says what to do when the setup fix itself fails or which document counts as the setup source
findings.fix: Name the source (the project's documented setup command only) and, if that command fails, record the command and error under Validation and mark the work unverified without a second attempt
